title: SAP Sales Process Coverage Map v0.3

meta.summary: Extends v0.2 from after-sales/billing coverage into production, project, recurring-delivery and cross-application Sales Order topology.

attribution.preferred_citation: Dzmitryi Kharlanau. "SAP Sales Process Coverage Map v0.3". CC BY-NC 4.0. https://dkharlanau.github.io/labs/enterprise-context/sales-processes/coverage/

new_process_records.title: Assemble-to-Order / Assembly Processing
new_process_records.decision_axis: sales-order processing directly creates or controls a linked assembly object and promise follows component/assembly feasibility

new_process_records.title: Engineer-to-Order / Sales from Project Stock
new_process_records.decision_axis: WBS/project stock and engineering become the execution/cost backbone for customer-specific supply

new_process_records.title: Sales Order Processing - Project-Based Services
new_process_records.decision_axis: customer project execution and billing evidence replace the normal stock-delivery fulfillment model

new_process_records.title: Recurring Delivery of Physical Products from Subscription
new_process_records.decision_axis: subscription lifecycle owns recurring commitment while generated sales orders execute each physical cycle

modeling_rule: A new source system does not create a new sales process by itself. Model business semantics with SD.*, origin/orchestration with ORC.SD.*, the next execution owner with INT.SD.*, and asynchronous domain signals with EVT.SD.*.

high_value_comparisons.question: Does customer-specific supply start through normal planning or does the sales order create/control the assembly object immediately?
Is the execution/cost segment the sales order or a WBS/project with engineering and project stock?
Is the project producing a customer-specific product or delivering service work/cost as the billing evidence?
Same sales process, different channel/origin contract. What synchronous answers and correlation keys does each origin require?
